objects.carrier: A 12-dimensional real vector space C with a labelled basis beta_g indexed by the frozen A4 elements and positive inner product H.
objects.pointer: A two-dimensional real space P with labelled basis r_0,r_1 of unit vectors and fixed overlap eta in (-1,1). Eta is an external parameter, not quotiented.
objects.joint: C tensor P with the product inner product; no mixing of carrier and pointer factors is allowed as a realization gauge.
objects.operations: Linear extensions of the eight frozen labelled permutations on beta_g tensor r_b, with literal word histories retained.
objects.preparations: Every labelled beta_g tensor r_0. These are mathematical amplitude vectors, not claimed normalized quantum states or autonomous physical preparations.
objects.readings: On the distinguished labelled states beta_g tensor r_b, the native reader returns b. No deterministic Boolean reader or Born instrument on arbitrary superpositions is supplied.
objects.normalization: Each feature sum_{g:g(a)=b} beta_g for the six off-diagonal queries has squared norm one. This fixes c=1/3 if H=cI in the labelled basis.
objects.admissible_subspace: For Output A, additionally require all eight operation matrices to be isometries. The equivalence definition itself does not assume that property has been proved.

morphisms.type: Invertible real linear A:C->C' and B:P->P', acting jointly as A tensor B.
label_laws: A beta_g = beta'_g for every fixed source label g
pairing_laws: A^T H' A = H in coordinate presentations
B^T R' B = R in coordinate presentations
morphisms.operation_law: (A tensor B) rho(w) = rho'(w) (A tensor B) for every identical literal word w; generator intertwining suffices by induction.
morphisms.preparation_and_reading: Carry each named preparation to its namesake, preserve the pointer answer on all distinguished labelled states and preserve every future word reading.
morphisms.composition: Ordinary composition of the two factor maps; inverses are their actual linear inverses; identity maps retain each label.
morphisms.uniqueness_boundary: The labelled bases determine A and B uniquely when a morphism exists. Existence is equality of the two labelled Gram matrices. This gauge does not choose those Grams.

excluded: Permuting source or pointer labels while calling the named task unchanged
Rescaling the normalized pairing while leaving the labelled preparations and features fixed
Entangling the carrier and pointer coordinate factors as a gauge move
Quotienting histories merely because their endpoint operators agree
Claiming arbitrary-superposition readout or physical control from this mathematical equivalence
scale_boundary: Before normalization the theorem H=cI has a free common scale. Distinct c are not isometric objects preserving the fixed labelled basis; unit-feature normalization selects one representative by convention, not a physical energy calibration.
coordinate_example: Any invertible shear A is allowed if beta'=A beta and H'=A^{-T} H A^{-1}, with operations conjugated and labels unchanged.
refusal_examples: Changing H from I/3 to (I+J/9)/4 while fixing beta is not a coordinate equivalence
Changing eta from 0 to 1/2 is not an allowed pointer gauge
Swapping r_0 and r_1 is not record-label-preserving
